# secureaccess_application_list (Data Source)

This data source reads the Application List.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_application_list" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `name` (String) The descriptive label for the Application List.

### Read-Only

- `application_category_ids` (Set of Number) The list of IDs of the Application Categories in the Application List.
- `application_ids` (Set of Number) The list of IDs of the Applications in the Application List.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Specifies whether the Application List is the default Application List.
